text:
Anna Lewis: Kicking off account + network scaffold for ap-southeast-4 (new GPU region). Need consensus on CIDR, subnets for gpu/bastion/mgmt, peering to shared-services, and quota checks. Who's taking handoff?

Mike Rivera: I'll own the cloud-account parts. Quick asks: do we want org-standard CIDR block or carve a new /20 for this region? Also tagging @Raj for GPU SKU availability.

Raj Singh: Heads up — ap-southeast-4 currently has limited A100 stock, A10G and T4 are available. If the workload needs A100, we should plan fallback to mls-optimized nodes or cross-region routing to eu-west-1.

Lina Park: For CIDR I'd prefer we follow the org template: 10.84.0.0/18 reserved for APAC, then per-project /22. Suggest using 10.84.64.0/22 for the gpu-project to avoid overlap with existing ap-southeast3.

Mike Rivera: That works. Proposed subnet plan: 
- gpu-subnet: 10.84.64.0/24 (GPU nodes, private)
- mgmt-subnet: 10.84.65.0/26 (control plane, k8s api, admin access)
- bastion-subnet: 10.84.65.64/27 (bastion NAT and jump hosts)
- ops-subnet: 10.84.65.128/26 (monitoring, logging, egress proxies)

Anna Lewis: Nice. Can we also add a /28 for vpn termination? want predictable NAT IPs for support.

Lina Park: yes, reserve 10.84.65.192/28 for VPN/NAT.

Mike Rivera: I'm going to start a minimal terraform module to create the project, VPC, subnets, and private service connections. Will post a plan.

sre-bot: New terraform run queued by mike-r:terraform-runner on workspace ap-se4-gpu. Plan ID: trf-2035-001

Mike Rivera: Plan output (high level):
```
- google_project.project created
- google_compute_network.vpc created
- google_compute_subnetwork.gpu-subnet created
- google_compute_subnetwork.mgmt-subnet created
```
No changes to routes or peering yet.

Anna Lewis: For peering, we need to connect to shared-services project (logging/backup) and to the central identity project. Any constraints?

Raj Singh: Shared-services peering OK, but note that cloud provider enforces 50 peerings per VPC in this org. If we hit that limit, we need to use VPN/HA endpoints or transit. Also multi-region egress costs could be significant if backups go cross-region; estimate ~0.06 USD/GB on average.

Lina Park: Suggest we enable Private Service Connect for logging ingestion to avoid full mesh peering. That reduces peering footprint and keeps traffic within backbone.

Mike Rivera: Agree. I'll add PSC endpoints for logging and KMS access. Also adding route tag for GPU nodes to prefer local nat-gateway for egress to minimize cross-region charges.

Anna Lewis: Security and KMS — do we want customer-managed keys in this region or fallback to central keyring?

Lina Park: For PII workloads, per-customer KMS in region preferred. For general infra we can use central keyring with restricted bindings. We need a ticket to security for key provisioning.

Raj Singh: Quick checklist for handoff to infra-oncall: 
- project created and labelled (team/gpu-project)
- VPC + subnets applied
- PSC endpoints for logging/KMS configured
- GPU quota request submitted (A100 or fallback A10G)
- Bastion and VPN reserved IPs applied
- Terraform plan + state approved in infra-states

Mike Rivera: I'll create the quota support ticket now and fill the org template. ETA for first smoke cluster: 48h after quotas are approved.

Anna Lewis: Great. Can someone run a quick connectivity smoke once the TF apply finishes? ping @sre-bot to create a smoke run.

sre-bot: Smoke test job created: smoke-ap-se4-203501. Steps: 1) verify subnets, 2) create small node pool (t4), 3) bootstrap k8s control plane, 4) run simple pod e2e.

Lina Park: Minor note — firewall rules: allow node->metadata(169.254.169.254) for image pulls, allow k8s control plane ports 6443 from mgmt-subnet. Also restrict SSH to bastion only.

Mike Rivera: Got it. I'll include the firewall rules in the module. Posting PR in ~30m.

Anna Lewis: Thanks team. We'll reconvene 2pm UTC for handoff once PR merges. :thumbsup:

Raj Singh: If quotas stall, we fall back to spinning small T4-based dev cluster in the same project to validate pipelines.

Mike Rivera: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/terraform/-/merge_requests/4523 (includes CIDR vars and PSC modules)

Anna Lewis: LGTM. Marking this thread for the handoff record.

sre-bot: Thread closed by anna.lewis via /close-thread
